first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: A man with short black hair moving along the concrete median barrier, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, a red tie, black trousers, and black shoes.

entities.name: queue of vehicles in traffic congestion
entities.identification: A collection of densely arranged multicolored vehicles on both sides of the concrete median barrier and in the distance, excluding Vehicle D and the separately listed dark blue car roof in the foreground.

entities.name: clear blue sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of light blue sky above the vehicles, with a long, narrow white cloud streak in the image's upper left.

entities.name: concrete guardrail
entities.identification: A continuous low gray wall behind the vehicles on the image-left side, extending along the road's outer edge.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: A light gray, silver-white sedan in the near foreground on the image-left side of the concrete median barrier, with a wide hood and dark windshield.

entities.name: surrounding crowd
entities.identification: A collection of other people between the vehicles, beside the windows, and near the car roofs, excluding Person F, Person G, and Person H.

entities.name: Person H
entities.identification: A long-haired woman behind Person F, supporting their body against the concrete median barrier and extending their legs toward Vehicle D; a purple sleeveless top and black trousers are visible later in the clip.

entities.name: dark blue car roof in the foreground
entities.identification: A dark blue curved car roof partially in frame at the image's lower right, with its lower edge adjoining a dark car window.

entities.name: bridge deck roadway
entities.identification: The light gray hard road surface visible through gaps between vehicles on both sides of the concrete median barrier.

entities.name: concrete median barrier
entities.identification: A solid light gray-beige dividing wall between the two lines of vehicles, with a narrow top surface and a visible sloping side.

entities.name: Person G
entities.identification: A woman with fluffy short orange hair behind Vehicle D near a yellow vehicle, wearing a gray-green to dark gray sleeveless top.
